title: Notes:
description:
port of Mania-Replay-Master: renders falling notes colored by judgement plus the actual key actions (hit offsets) in real time while playing or watching a replay.

hidden outside gameplay. judgement windows follow the active system: osu!stable (v1 / scorev2) and osu!lazer (original / classic mod), including mod-adjusted OD and rate.

place this counter as an OBS browser source or in the tosu ingame overlay, then size/position it freely.
value: feel free to adjust this text. it does nothing.

title: Colour: Unjudged
description: colour of notes that have not been hit yet

title: Note Height
description: note block height in playfield units (playfield is 480 wide)

title: Note Border Width
description: notes are drawn as hollow outlined rectangles like the reference renderer

title: Action Height
description: height of the filled key action blocks / held-note dashes

title: Hit Position (60 - 470)
description: vertical position of the judgement line in playfield units; keep it small so only a short preview strip stays above the line and the judged area below becomes the main review region

title: Judgement Review Time (ms)
description: minimum time notes and actions remain visible after the judgement line; lowers the fall speed automatically if the scroll speed would be too fast (default 1500)

title: Stats Panel Scale
description: size of the judgement / accuracy / UR panel in the top-left corner

title: Mania Scroll Speed Override (0 = game)
description: 1 - 40, 0 uses the scroll speed reported by tosu

title: Show Key Actions
description: draws the actual keypress position and the early / late offset connector

title: Render Scale (%)
description: scales the playfield inside the counter window

title: FPS Limit (0 = unlimited)
description: cap the redraw rate (e.g. 60) if the ingame overlay stutters
